summary: Iteration 22 (Rejouer button + bigger cards 75/62px + friend invite/presence + DuoSetup search/online-filter) validated end-to-end. BACKEND 9/9 PASS: POST /api/presence/ping returns {ok:true} (401 without auth); GET /api/friends now surfaces online field — verified True after tester2 pings, False after setting last_active 300s in the past directly in Mongo; GET /api/matchmaking/duo/candidates entries include online field; POST /api/matchmaking/duo/invite {mode:'vs_ai', match_type:'short'} from tester1 → tester2 creates a duo invite, appears in tester2 /api/notifications.duo_invites, tester2 accept returns {ok:true, mode:'vs_ai', match_type:'short', game_id:'g_*'} and BOTH players' /api/matchmaking/status = {status:'found', game_id:same}; both players successfully connect the WebSocket /api/ws/game/{id}?token=… and receive a first non-error JSON state; bad mode → 400; self-invite → 400. FRONTEND (viewport 844x390, tester1 via /auth login, tester2 kept online by direct /api/presence/ping): (A) Friends screen — presence-Tester2-off + no invite-game-Tester2 button when tester2 is stale, presence-Tester2-on + invite-game-Tester2 button visible after ping; friends-online-filter chip toggles list correctly (empty state with friends-empty-state when only friend is offline, tester2 row re-appears when tester2 pings and filter is ON). (B) invite-game-Tester2 → invite-game-modal renders invite-mt-short, invite-mt-long, invite-mode-online AND invite-mode-ai; clicking invite-mode-ai POSTs a duo invite and router.pushes /matchmaking?type=short&duo=1 with 'En attente de Tester2…' waiting screen — correct behaviour (screenshot iter22_after_ai.png). (C) Home → play-online-card → online-mode-duo toggle reveals duo-setup with duo-search-input, duo-online-filter chip, duo-candidate-Tester2 + duo-presence-Tester2-on green dot; searching 'ZZZZZ' shows 'Aucun joueur trouvé' and hides Tester2, searching 'Tes' brings Tester2 back; duo-online-filter toggle keeps Tester2 visible when they are online. (D) Card sizes verified from source: HandFan cardW=Math.min(75, …) and TrickArea CARD_W=62 (files /app/frontend/src/components/game/HandFan.tsx:60 and TrickArea.tsx:17). (E) Solo game creation via /solo works; bidding-panel appears; bid-suit-S + bid-value-160 + announce-bid-button flow works (Contré chip observed when bots decide to double). PARTIAL: reaching the match-end-overlay by fully playing a short match via hand-card-* clicks is time-consuming (200-250s of bot/animation cycles) and exceeds the 120s browser automation cap in this environment; the replay-button rendering + wiring is verified via code review (HandEndModal.tsx lines 260-268 renders <ChunkyButton testID='replay-button' … onPress={onReplay}/>; game/[id].tsx:665-672 passes onReplay=replay when state.origin!=='private', and replay() calls POST /api/solo → router.replace('/game/{new_id}') — this exact API pattern was executed successfully during the backend test — solo POST returns a new game_id and navigating loads bidding-panel again). Recommend main agent do one manual pass or short automated regression by directly instrumenting a match with 121-target and a rigged 160 capot to trigger match-end deterministically. REGRESSION: solo bidding-panel + hand-card interactions still work (iter22_after_bid.png). Only lingering non-blocking console warnings persist (shadow* deprecation + transform-origin) — unchanged since iter 18-21.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:322-342 — ONLINE_WINDOW_SECONDS = 90 aligns with spec. presence_ping updates users.last_active via time.time(). user_brief pops last_active and computes online = (now - last_active) < 90. Clean.
server.py:480-504 — /matchmaking/duo/candidates returns both friends and recent coplayers, each with an online field. Correct.
server.py:507-526 — /matchmaking/duo/invite validates mode ∈ {online,vs_ai}, match_type ∈ {short,long}, forbids self, requires (friend OR recent coplayer). Correct.

matchmaking.py:95-120 — accept_duo_invite for vs_ai atomically deletes the invite, then create_game([human, bot0, human, bot1]) with humans on seats 0 & 2 (correct duo seating), sets ranked=False and origin='solo', pushes matched status for BOTH humans. Both /matchmaking/status responses were verified {status:'found', game_id:same} in test_iter22.
HandEndModal.tsx:260-268 — replay-button only rendered when onReplay is defined; back-home-button becomes secondary variant with reduced top margin — a nice UX for showing replay as primary. Correct.
game/[id].tsx:276-288 — replay() branches: solo → api.post('/solo') and router.replace; online → router.replace('/matchmaking?type=X') — matches spec. Uses replace (not push), so back nav is clean.
friends.tsx:294-310 — invite-game-{username} button only rendered when item.online is true; offline friends see a heart icon instead. Correct gate.
friends.tsx:322-370 — invite-game-modal exposes mt chips + online + ai modes with distinct testIDs. Modal renders under Modal transparent — no overlay issues observed.

DuoSetup.tsx:73-127 — candidates filtered by search + online chip; presence dots use dedicated testIDs. Search returns 'Aucun joueur trouvé' path is standard React state — verified visually and via testID absence.

AuthContext.tsx:124-138 — heartbeat 30s + AppState 'active' re-ping. Ping starts synchronously when token becomes non-null. Note: on web, if user backgrounds tab for >90s browser may throttle setInterval past 90s — friends will briefly see them as offline until they refocus. Acceptable trade-off but worth documenting.
HandFan.tsx:60 and TrickArea.tsx:17 — cardW = Math.min(75, …) and CARD_W = 62 confirmed. Matches spec (+10% from prior 68/56).

The pymongo module is NOT available inside the browser automation subprocess — do direct DB mutations via /app/backend python and requests, then run browser automation.
